items.source: Build the TestContext for the BootstrapContext associated with this bootstrapper.
items.translation: 为与此引导器关联的BootstrapContext接口构建TestContext接口。

items.source: Get the BootstrapContext associated with this bootstrapper.
items.translation: 获取与此引导器关联的BootstrapContext接口。

items.source: Set the BootstrapContext to be used by this bootstrapper.
items.translation: 将 `BootstrapContext` 设置为此引导器所用。

items.source: If a bootstrapper is not explicitly configured via @BootstrapWith, either the DefaultTestContextBootstrapper or the WebTestContextBootstrapper will be used, depending on the presence of @WebAppConfiguration.
items.translation: 如果未通过 `@BootstrapWith` 显式配置引导器，则会根据是否存在 `@WebAppConfiguration` 使用 `DefaultTestContextBootstrapper` 或 `WebTestContextBootstrapper`。

items.source: If @TestExecutionListeners is not present on the test class in the BootstrapContext, default listeners should be returned. Furthermore, default listeners must be sorted using AnnotationAwareOrderComparator.
items.translation: 如果 `BootstrapContext` 中的测试类上不存在 `@TestExecutionListeners`，则应返回默认监听器。此外，必须使用 AnnotationAwareOrderComparator 对默认监听器进行排序。

items.source: The inheritListeners flag of @TestExecutionListeners must be taken into consideration. Specifically, if the inheritListeners flag is set to true, listeners declared for a given test class must be appended to the end of the list of listeners declared in superclasses or enclosing classes.
items.translation: `inheritListeners` 标志的 `@TestExecutionListeners` 必须予以考虑。具体而言，如果 `inheritListeners` 标志设置为 `true`，则为给定测试类声明的监听器必须附加到父类或封装类中声明的监听器列表末尾。

items.source: A TestContextBootstrapper is used by the TestContextManager to get the TestExecutionListeners for the current test and to build the TestContext that it manages.
items.translation: `TestContextBootstrapper` 由 `TestContextManager` 使用，用于获取当前测试的 `TestExecutionListeners`，并构建其管理的 `TestContext`。

items.source: WARNING: this SPI will likely change in the future in order to accommodate new requirements. Implementers are therefore strongly encouraged not to implement this interface directly but rather to extend AbstractTestContextBootstrapper or one of its concrete subclasses instead.
items.translation: 警告：此 SPI 未来可能会发生变化，以满足新的需求。因此，强烈建议实现者不要直接实现此接口，而是扩展AbstractTestContextBootstrapper或其具体子类之一。

items.source: Concrete implementations are free to determine what comprises the set of default listeners. However, by default, the Spring TestContext Framework will use the SpringFactoriesLoader mechanism to look up all TestExecutionListener class names configured in all META-INF/spring.factories files on the classpath.
items.translation: 具体实现可以自由决定默认监听器的组成。然而，默认情况下，Spring TestContext 框架将使用SpringFactoriesLoader机制来查找类路径上所有META-INF/spring.factories文件中配置的TestExecutionListener类名。

items.source: Note that the implementation of buildTestContext() should typically delegate to this method when constructing the TestContext.
items.translation: 注意，buildTestContext() 的实现通常应在构建 TestContext 时委托给此方法。

items.source: A custom bootstrapping strategy can be configured for a test class (or test class hierarchy) via @BootstrapWith, either directly or as a meta-annotation.
items.translation: 可以通过 `@BootstrapWith` 为测试类（或测试类层次结构）配置自定义引导策略，该注解可以直接使用，也可以作为元注解使用。

items.source: Get a list of newly instantiated TestExecutionListeners for the test class in the BootstrapContext associated with this bootstrapper.
items.translation: 获取此引导程序关联的BootstrapContext中测试类的新实例化TestExecutionListeners列表。

items.source: Build the merged context configuration for the test class in the BootstrapContext associated with this bootstrapper.
items.translation: 为此引导器关联的 BootstrapContext 中的测试类构建合并上下文配置。

items.source: Context hierarchies declared via @ContextHierarchy and @ContextConfiguration
items.translation: 通过 `@ContextHierarchy` 和 `@ContextConfiguration` 声明的上下文层次结构

items.source: Context initializers declared via ContextConfiguration.initializers()
items.translation: 上下文初始化器 通过 ContextConfiguration.initializers() 声明

items.source: If a ContextLoader class has been explicitly declared via ContextConfiguration.loader(), use it.
items.translation: 如果已通过ContextConfiguration.loader()显式声明了ContextLoader类，则使用它。

items.source: a new TestContext, never null
items.translation: 一个新的TestContext，永远不为null。

items.source: Active bean definition profiles declared via @ActiveProfiles
items.translation: 通过 `@ActiveProfiles` 声明的主动 Bean 定义配置文件。

items.source: Test property sources declared via @TestPropertySource
items.translation: 通过 `@TestPropertySource` 声明的测试属性源

items.source: Otherwise, concrete implementations are free to determine which ContextLoader class to use as a default.
items.translation: 否则，具体实现可以自由决定使用哪个 `ContextLoader` 类作为默认值。

items.source: the merged context configuration, never null
items.translation: 合并后的上下文配置，永远不为null。

items.source: a list of TestExecutionListener instances
items.translation: 一个TestExecutionListener实例列表

items.translation: 实现说明

items.source: Concrete implementations must provide a public no-args constructor.
items.translation: 具体实现必须提供一个public无参构造函数。
